Subject: Infra boundary & deployment mode: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — follow-up

Hi Elena / FinBay team,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of requirements you flagged:
- Data isolation: no shared compute with unrelated tenants for sensitive workloads.
- Key management: customer-managed keys (BYOK) for encryption-at-rest.
- Auditability: 7+ year retention for audit logs and exportable tamper-evident logs.
- Network: VPC peering or private connectivity; eventual on-prem migration is in scope.
- POC ask: prefer to start on a Dedicated pool with VPC peering, then evaluate Private/on-prem later.

Options we discussed (high-level):
- Hosted API: easiest to start but does not meet strict isolation/BYOK needs by default.
- Dedicated: isolated GPU pools; can be configured to reduce cross-tenant exposure and support BYOK in many cases.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full network isolation, customer-controlled control plane, supports stricter KMS/retention controls.

Attachments: I attached a short SOC2 summary and your security questionnaire for reference.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marissa to confirm which Dedicated configurations support BYOK and what isolation guarantees we can commit to in an SOW.
2) Schedule a 30–45m technical deep-dive (SE + infra engineer) to validate network/KMS requirements and capture any policy-level blocking items.
3) We'll follow up with a proposed POC plan (timeline, success criteria, and SOW/quote).

Are you available for a tech deep-dive on Thu 3/19 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 3/20 9:00–10:00 PT?

Thanks,
Ben

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) BYOK is non-negotiable for the PII workload — we need to hold the root KMS keys in our cloud account and be able to rotate/disable them on demand.
2) Compute isolation: Dedicated must guarantee no co-located VMs/GPUs with third parties; unstated "soft" isolation won’t pass internal audit.
3) Audit logs: retention needs to be exportable to our SIEM and retained for 7 years. Immutable log options preferred.
4) Network: we want VPC peering for initial POC; longer-term we may ask for an on-prem agent or air-gapped option.

Attached is a short formal security questionnaire with more specifics — answered by our security team.

We can do Thu 3/19 10:00–10:30 PT for the tech call. Please include your SE and the engineer who can speak to KMS and VPC peering.

Elena / Ben — quick technical note ahead of the deep-dive to set expectations and narrow questions: 

Short answers to the items Elena listed:
- BYOK: Supported for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we offer managed keys only. For Dedicated, BYOK is supported in our Dedicated offering via a customer KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). Caveat: key lifecycle operations may require a short maintenance window for some rotations; we’ll document the exact steps in the SOW.
- Compute isolation: Dedicated uses reserved GPU pools and workload isolation at the hypervisor/container boundary. We can contractually commit to no noisy-neighbor VMs and provide evidence (placement reports). For the strongest guarantee we recommend Private (VPC/on-prem) where customer owns networking and control plane.
- Audit logs / retention: We can stream structured audit logs to your SIEM (Syslog/HTTPS) and provide exportable archives for long-term retention. For immutable logs we support append-only export to your S3 bucket or equivalent via service account.
- VPC peering: Available for both Dedicated (in supported regions) and Private. For Dedicated we do VPC peering into a dedicated subnet; for Private we can do VPC peering + routing to on-prem.

Open items for the call that I'd like to cover:
1) Confirm FinBay's KMS provider and whether HSM-backed keys are required.
2) Expected throughput and average sequence lengths for POC so we can size Dedicated pool.
3) Specific SIEM integration endpoint and log format expectations.
4) Timeline constraints: how quickly you need the POC up (typical Dedicated lead time is 2–4 weeks depending on capacity).

I attached our Private deployment checklist and a simple network diagram to help the conversation. If we can get answers to 1–3 before the call that will make the session much more efficient.

—Marissa
